SDGN.description: Seismic Design Type (SDGN). A single Assign value object holding the seismic design classification (NTYPE) applied to the RC design database entry.

NTYPE.description: Seismic Design Type. Case-insensitive enum (matched on wire strings). Drives whether the member is treated as seismic, non-seismic, or non-seismic force-resisting in the design.
